messages:
anya: quick favor — can someone run a short perf + quality sweep on the int4+FP8 hybrid for the conv-qc-1000 promptset? target p95 latency <= 60ms on g5.2x, and report token-level perplexity delta vs baseline. please run both KV-warm and KV-cold. will need a perf profile (cpu/gpu timelines) and any obvious outliers. tag me when done. thanks :pray:

cheng: on it. I'll queue a couple of short runs on the dedicated pool (d4) first to sanity-check, then run on g5.2x. which model variant + commit? any batch size / seq len you care about?

marco: can run on the dedicated pool for lower variance. ping me if you want reserved nodes — I can spin 2 nodes for a couple hours.

anya: model: redwood-v1-open-int4-fp8-hybrid@ce3f2b9. baseline is redwood-v1-open-int8@b1a4c00. use batch_size=1 and also batch_size=4. primary seq lengths: 64 and 1024. include tail-check (longseq) bucket.

mike: fyi i saw a ~0.8% BLEU/perf quality drop on longseq in yesterday's sweep when we switched kernel scheduling. might be related to KV flush timing. recommend adding --tail-check and a diff against baseline for last 200 tokens.

sam: also confirm RNG seed and detokenization flags — small diffs can blow perplexity. set --seed=42 and --detok=true for both runs.

cheng: queued. sample run CLI (using bench-run v0.9):
```
bench-run \
  --model redwood-v1-open-int4-fp8-hybrid@ce3f2b9 \
  --dataset conv-qc-1000 \
  --seq-lens 64,1024 \
  --batch-sizes 1,4 \
  --kv-warm true,false \
  --tail-check true \
  --seed 42 \
  --profile gpu,cpu \
  --out /tmp/quant-sweep/ce3f2b9/\
```
I'll post logs & perf profiles when done.

ci-bot: artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/2141590000/quant-sweep-ce3f2b9.tar.gz (contains perf traces, token diffs, and raw outputs) :package:

leah: quick CR ping — my PR #3127 touches the quant scheduler fallback. if you see different kernel choices between runs, that's likely from that PR. can someone note kernel selection in the profile?

marco: quick summary from the g5.2x runs (warm/cold aggregated): p95 latency (seq64,b1): 48ms (warm) / 65ms (cold); p95 latency (seq1024,b1): 420ms (warm) / 470ms (cold). throughput b4: 1.9x (warm). token-level perplexity delta vs int8 baseline: +0.6% (seq64), +1.2% (seq1024), but tail (last 200 tokens) shows +2.3% on a subset of prompts (likely long-context attenuation). attached perf traces show elevated memcpy peaks around kernel-switch events.

anya: great, thanks everyone. action items: 1) cheng/marco — can you rerun a focused longseq tail reproducer with --kv-chunk=128 and capture kernel selection logs? 2) leah — if CR #3127 is the culprit, push a quick revert patch for testing. 3) mike/sam — compile a short regression note with example prompt ids showing the +2.3% tail delta. I'll sync this at tomorrow's eng-runtime standup. :thumbsup:
